provenance: Proxy baseline derived from the canonical build specification and redacted Athena run shapes; human assistive-technology validation remains open.

journeys.title: First-run authentication and provider failure recovery

steps.expectedSemantic: Athena requests provider authentication without exposing the entered credential.

steps.action: Return a recoverable provider error on the first turn.
steps.expectedSemantic: Athena reports Failed with a bounded recovery route and preserves the session.
Athena accepts the new turn without requiring a restart or sighted recovery.

journeys.title: Broad objective, local orientation, interruption, and completion

steps.action: Ask Athena to get the release ready.
steps.expectedSemantic: Status retains the user objective and distinguishes runtime facts from agent assertions.
Athena answers locally without a model call and names the next expected transition.

steps.action: Interrupt active work, then resume the durable session.
steps.expectedSemantic: Cancellation is acknowledged and resumed work retains the objective and evidence.

steps.action: Finish the resumed run with verified gates.
steps.expectedSemantic: Athena reports Completed once and preserves the verified outcome.

journeys.title: Read-only inspection followed by an approved edit

steps.action: Inspect several files using read-only tools.
steps.expectedSemantic: Routine successful inspection stays quiet while current activity remains queryable.

steps.action: Request permission for a multi-file mutation.
steps.expectedSemantic: Permission names the action, target, reason, choices, and detail route without losing context.

steps.action: Deny the first request and allow a revised bounded request.
steps.expectedSemantic: Requests remain paired and FIFO; denial does not authorize the action.

journeys.title: Child and background work with one material failure

steps.action: Start one child run and one foreground-owned background task.
steps.expectedSemantic: Status reports one child and one background task without narrating every progress tick.

steps.action: Complete the child and fail the background task.
steps.expectedSemantic: The aggregate updates, the failure remains material, and recovery points to trace evidence.
Athena returns bounded detail without replaying raw tool output.

journeys.title: Session resume, compaction, and final verified outcome

steps.action: Resume a durable session after process exit.
steps.expectedSemantic: Athena restores prior messages and starts a new isolated run identity.

steps.action: Compact model context while retaining trace evidence.
steps.expectedSemantic: Compaction does not replace semantic truth or erase unresolved attention.

steps.action: Record the final verified run result.
steps.expectedSemantic: Completed or Failed is derived from runtime evidence rather than assistant prose.
